# Veil Protocol

> Zero-Knowledge Privacy Layer for Uniswap v4 on Robinhood Chain (Chain ID: 4663)
> Website: https://www.veilpools.tech
> App: https://www.veilpools.tech/trade

## Overview
Veil brings zero-knowledge privacy directly to Uniswap v4 swaps on Robinhood Chain:
- **Swap-to-Shield**: Swap any token on Uniswap v4 and enter the shielded pool in a single atomic transaction. Router maintains a strict invariant of 0 held balance.
- **Shielded Swap**: Exchange between shielded token pools without leaving any public wallet trace on-chain (single-note, multi-note up to 8 notes, or direct-payout mode).
- **ZK-Gated Pools**: Uniswap v4 hook restricts swaps to addresses with valid ZK attestations during launch windows.
- **Protocol Fee Hook**: 30 bps per swap routed to VeilTreasury — 70% funds autonomous on-chain buyback & burns of the Veil token.

## Key Technical Specifications
- **ZK Proof System**: Groth16 SNARKs with Poseidon hash function.
- **Privacy Architecture**: 0xbow v1.2.1 cryptographic primitives with LeanIMT Merkle tree (depth 20).
- **Fixed Denomination**: Uniform 0.001 ETH and 0.001 VEIL deposit notes for mathematical unlinkability.
- **Execution Environment**: Robinhood Chain Mainnet (EVM Cancun, Chain ID 4663).
- **AMM Hook**: Uniswap v4 CREATE2 deployed Hook (0x20c4 address flag).

## Core Pages & Endpoints
- `/trade` - Shielded trading desk (Shield, Shielded Swap, Withdraw, Vault, Attestation).
- `/contracts` - Live on-chain deployed contract addresses, verification status, and parameters.
- `/burn` - Treasury fee ledger and autonomous burn records.
- `/status` - Live network status and RPC health check.
- `/docs/asp-policy` - Association Set Provider (ASP) policy and rules.
- `/privacy` - Privacy disclosures (zero server-side custody, client-side proof generation).
- `/terms` - Terms of service.
